Razaullah to Root, THATS OUT!! Lbw!!

Razaullah to Root, out Lbw!! Root is trapped LBW and wastes a review. Dream start for Razaullah. A wicket in his first over in Tests and no wonder he is all smiles. Has got one of the best-ever too. 89mph and slingy, skids on from a good length and nips back in to catch the kneeroll of the front pad as Root is beaten for pace. Chris Gaffaney has the finger up immediately and ball-tracking shows it to be three reds. Razaullah had been on the money for the first three deliveries and this rushed Root. Big wicket.
